summary: Hecla Mining filed an 8-K announcing second-quarter 2026 operating and financial results and declared routine dividends: $0.00375 per common share (record Aug 26, 2026; payable Sep 10, 2026) and $0.875 per Series B convertible preferred share (record Sep 15, 2026; payable Oct 1, 2026). The filing contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or strategic review; it is a standard earnings and dividend announcement. The preferred dividend amount is contractual, and the common dividend reflects ordinary capital return policy. Watch for future operational updates or capital allocation shifts, but no risk-arb angle applies.
